spoken_summary: Donovan Mitchell speaks passionately about recurring "senseless violence" in Minnesota, which he says has sadly "become the norm." He emphasizes the "human element" and expresses frustration that society has become "desensitized." He recalls being in a hotel on lockdown in Minnesota during a previous incident, feeling the proximity of the event. He argues that the focus should be on shared humanity rather than taking sides, stating that what is happening is "just not right."
